result.description: For every fifteenth-review behavior (TR-MCP-USECASE-018), write the consumer test and the real-service, kernel, provider, or adversarial test with scripted data first and prove them against that data in a green mock gate with negative controls before production changes (BDPv4: no red tests); then bind the same cases to production and prove focused and cumulative GREEN with exact zero-failure, zero-skip, zero-abort, and zero-inconclusive accounting from C:-physical artifacts. Platform-specific cases are integration tests that run in their host's lane (TR-MCP-NUKE-019).
